Hi all — I pulled the quick query against our metering buckets and the window Marta flagged shows an unusual session reconnect pattern. Preliminary findings:

- Between 2026-06-29T23:28:43Z and 2026-06-30T00:11:06Z there are ~1,120 streaming session records for account NIM-4521 where session_id changed but user_token_id remained identical.
- Our current attribution rule treats reconnects within 30s as the same session; in this case there were intermittent network reconnects that caused the agent to restart and submit a fresh session_id; the streaming pipeline inadvertently double-counted the tail tokens in two session records during the conversion step.
- Currency conversion rounding: EUR totals are converted from USD at the daily FX rate; we identified two rounding adjustments applied after aggregation that produced a rounding delta of 1,274.42 EUR.
- VAT reversal: a reactive VAT correction was applied because the original invoice had an incorrect VAT country mapping (we show UK instead of DE). That reversal line is separate from the metering variance.

Proposal:
1) Place Invoice #20260630 on hold for collections immediately (we will not attempt to charge).
2) Issue a provisional credit of 26,040.00 EUR to correct the double-count and rounding delta; final credit to be confirmed after we ship the raw log export for your audit.
3) We will re-issue the invoice with the corrected VAT mapping and updated totals within 48 hours.

Action items: Rafael -> provide raw log export and CSV of the affected events (ETA 2 hours). Laura -> prepare provisional credit note template for approval. Vanessa -> confirm with Marta the VAT ID for the DE entity.

Attachments referenced: provisional_credit_template.docx (stub — output will be formal credit note PDF)

— Rafael Mendes
